variants.idea: Remove givens that give easy singles in row 8, box 8 and the centre column, so more cells need multi-step deductions.

idea: Thin out givens in different boxes so no unit is nearly complete.
Remove central and column givens that anchor the repeating pattern, forcing longer chains.
Remove corner-adjacent givens to reduce the easy singles at the box edges.
Fewer givens in rows 2, 5 and 7 make those rows and their boxes less constrained.
Remove givens across the middle and bottom so the lower half needs deeper reasoning.
Break up the nearly complete row 7 and the dense bottom-right area.
Remove scattered givens so no row, column or box is close to complete.
Weaken the heavily given row 5 and the bottom-right corner so eliminations are needed.
Spread removals across all bands to lower the number of immediate singles.
